remarks: Looking for a wonderful in town location, where you can feel the energy of "The Avenue". known for world class dining and shopping experiences, this location puts you at the center of everything. 10 mins to the Long island sound, Metro North, Golf, Tennis. 45 mins to theater, music, museums in Manhattan.  This elegant, 2 bedroom, 1 bath, Penthouse apartment is filled with natural light and beautiful wood floors. A blank canvas, perfect as a full time residence or as a Pied-a-terre while visiting friends, relatives or tending to business locally. One outdoor parking spot is assign. Enjoy as is, or perhaps create your dream "jewel box" of a home! I invite you to arrange a private tour.
